{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PY'
import io
p='specs/001-transactions/spec.md'
s=io.open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
lines=s.split('\n')
# find the three token assumption lines currently at the end
marks=[l for l in lines if l.startswith('- Idempotency tokens are per batch writer') or l.startswith('- Token comparison of') or l.startswith('- The token parameter is exclusive')]
assert len(marks)==3, marks
for m in marks:
    lines.remove(m)
s='\n'.join(lines)
anchor='## Conflicting Evidence - Resolved'
assert anchor in s
block=(' - Idempotency tokens are per batch writer instance: two different writer instances over the same database do not share token state, and no token data is written into user documents or storage.\n'
       '- Token comparison of "identical operations" is based on the full structural content of the submitted operation list (all fields, including any that would be rejected as unsupported); a batch that failed validation is not recorded, so its token remains free.\n'
       '- The token parameter is exclusive to `apply`; `preview` keeps its original signature and never touches token state.\n\n')
s=s.replace(anchor, block+anchor,1)
io.open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
print('fixed')
PY
grep -n "^##\|^###" specs/001-transactions/spec.md"}
